tree.heading: Period of award
tree.text: Scholarships awarded under this part shall be for a period of 1 academic year.

tree.heading: Use of scholarships
tree.text: Each individual awarded a scholarship under this part may use the scholarship for educational expenses at an institution of higher education.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 14114 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
